living_room.caption: And you forget where you are. Which you look at these uninterrupted views, this is pretty much the entire city right in front of you. Phenomenal. Rapping around the whole floor, glass walls reaching a height of 3 metres. Spanning 536 square metres, these wide open spaces are ethereal, airy and soft. Each one evoking a special vibe. I'm not sure where to sit, there's one couch set up after another along here, a view for every mood. And talk about expensive taste, this is over.

bathroom.caption: sexy adorned with golden marble. And the round bath is a beautiful contrast to the straight lines of what is a very linear bathroom. They go very well with the gold shower heads. All that's missing is some wine cheese and grapes.

kitchen.caption: beautifully crafted kitchen using the finest materials and finishes.

master_room.caption: rooms and if this one was mine I have breakfast in bed every weekend watching the sun rise over my head and I can just imagine the cozy feeling of sinking my toes into this super soft carpet. The bar
